entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hello, Alex. I'm calling because... well, I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm certainly sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into a return for you. To start, could you please provide me with your order number?
Yes, it's VF886-2145. It's for the cycling shoes. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I was just so excited for them, but they've been a complete letdown.

I see the order. Thank you. And I appreciate your loyalty to VeloFit. To understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the shoes or more of a personal preference or fit issue?

It's the fit. They just hurt my feet so much. Every single time I ride I get awful blisters on my heels. I even tried adjusting the cleats thinking that might help, but it didn't. I saved up for these, you know? I really needed this money back if they weren't going to work.
Getting blisters from new gear is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I completely understand your frustration. Let me just pull up your delivery date and review our policy.
Okay, I see here that the shoes were delivered 71 days ago. Let me just confirm our return guidelines... Yes, it looks like standard items are eligible for return within 90 days.
Since you are well within that window, I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file right now.
Oh, really? A full refund? That's... that's wonderful. Thank you so much, Alex. I was so worried I'd just be stuck with them. You've been a huge help.
Of course. We want to make sure you have gear that works for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. You've made my day. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
